_meta.note: A-024: English only in v1. Every UI string lives here; add de.json later with the same keys. Use ICU-style {placeholders}.

app.name: Plant Monitor
welcome.tagline: Know when your plants are thirsty. Set up a sensor in under 3 minutes.
welcome.privacy: By continuing you accept the privacy notice (data stored in the EU).
setup.hubNotInV1: Hub pairing is available in a later version.
plant.remove.title: Remove {plantName}?
plant.remove.warning: This permanently deletes the plant, all its readings, events, alerts, tips and photos. This cannot be undone.
plant.remove.confirmLabel: Type the plant name to confirm
plant.remove.confirm: Delete plant and all its data
plant.removed.title: {plantName} was removed
plant.removed.body: Readings and photos are deleted. Your sensor {sensorName} is still linked to your account.
plant.removed.keepSensor: Keep sensor (set up a new plant later)
plant.removed.releaseHint: Releasing unlinks it so anyone can set it up. It returns to setup mode after its next report. You can also do this later from the sensor list.
premium.title: Premium
premium.activatedByNilwerk: Premium is activated by Nilwerk. Contact us and we switch it on for your account.
auth.signUp.title: Create account
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signUp.checkEmail: Almost done. We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it, then sign in.
auth.error.invalidCredentials: E-mail or password is not right.
auth.error.emailTaken: There is already an account with this e-mail. Try signing in.
auth.error.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
auth.error.notConfigured: The app is not connected to a server yet.
auth.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
validation.email.invalid: Enter a valid e-mail, for example you@example.com.
profile.title: Profile
profile.plantsSoon: Your plant list is added in a later version.
deleteAccount.title: Delete account?
deleteAccount.warning: This permanently removes your plants, readings, photos, alerts and API keys. Your sensors are released and can be set up again.
deleteAccount.exportHint: Export your data before you delete. The JSON export includes all your photos and unlocks deleting once everything is saved. The CSV export does not contain photos and does not unlock deleting. Nothing can be recovered after deleting.
deleteAccount.error: The account could not be deleted, and some of your data may already be gone. Sign in again to check, then try again. If this keeps happening, contact the team.
premium.body: Free includes live values, 7-day charts, alerts, photos and export. Premium adds 30 / 90-day history, trends, care tips and AI access.
premium.noContact: Contact details are not configured in this build.
legal.line: Contact and privacy: {email}. E-mail is processed by Google (Gmail).
app.mockBanner: MOCK: test values and a fake sensor, not real data. No real account.
setup.ready.title: Add a sensor
setup.ready.putInSoil: Put the sensor in the soil
setup.ready.pressButton: Press the pinhole button until the LED blinks
setup.ready.permissionNote: The app asks for Bluetooth permission (and location on Android) so it can find the sensor.
setup.ready.none: No sensor found. Press the pinhole button until the LED blinks, keep your phone close and try again.
setup.ready.help: Sensor not found? Press the pinhole button again. Setup mode closes after 5 minutes.
setup.error.permission_denied: Bluetooth is not allowed. Allow Bluetooth (and location on Android) for this app in your phone settings, then try again.
setup.error.bluetooth_off: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and try again.
setup.error.not_available: Sensor setup needs the full app build because it uses Bluetooth. It is not available in this preview.
setup.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup.connect.title: Connect to your sensor
setup.connect.body: Type the code printed on the sensor label. It starts with NW1. The code proves the sensor is yours.
setup.connect.scanQr: Scanning the QR code is added with the Bluetooth build.
setup.connect.invalid: That does not look like a sensor code. Example: NW1:nw-a1b2c3d4e5f6:7KQ2M9XD
setup.connect.mismatch: That code belongs to a different sensor than {name}.
setup.error.wrong_code: Code doesn't match. Check the label and try again (5 tries, then press the button again).
setup.error.setup_closed: Setup mode closed. Press the pinhole button on the sensor again, then start over.
setup.error.not_found: Sensor not found. Press the pinhole button until the LED blinks and try again.
setup.wifi.title: Choose your Wi-Fi
setup.wifi.note: Only 2.4 GHz networks work. The password goes straight to the sensor, never to our cloud.
setup.wifi.none: No Wi-Fi networks found. Use "Other network" to type the name.
setup.name.title: Name your sensor
setup.name.label: Sensor name
setup.name.hint: For example: Basil on the sill
setup.link.title: Connecting
setup.linkError.wifi.title: Wi-Fi didn't work
setup.linkError.wifi_auth: The sensor couldn't join {ssid}. Wrong password?
setup.linkError.wifi_no_ap: The sensor couldn't find {ssid}. Move it closer to the router. Only 2.4 GHz networks work.
setup.linkError.wifi_timeout: The sensor took too long to join {ssid}. Move it closer to the router and try again.
setup.linkError.owned.title: Sensor already belongs to someone
setup.linkError.device_owned: Ask the previous owner to remove it from their account, or reset it with the pinhole button.
setup.linkError.resetHint: Press the pinhole button on the sensor until the LED blinks, then start setup again.
setup.linkError.claim.title: Linking to your account failed
setup.linkError.claim_network: No connection to the server. Check the sensor's Wi-Fi and your internet.
setup.linkError.claim_server: The server could not link the sensor. Please try again.
setup.linkError.claim_token_invalid: The setup code expired. Start setup again.
setup.photo.title: Take a photo
setup.photo.body: A photo of the plant. It stays on your phone until the plant is saved.
setup.photo.unsupported: Photos are not available in this version yet. The plant is saved without one.
setup.details.title: About your plant
setup.details.name: Plant name
setup.details.saveError: The save could not be confirmed. Check your plant list before you try again.
setup.move.title: This sensor already has a plant
setup.move.body: Choose what happens to the sensor. Nothing has changed yet.
setup.move.keep: Keep the sensor on its current plant
setup.move.keepHint: Keeping the sensor here does not save the plant you just entered. Check your plant list first, in case it was already saved.
setup.move.move: Move the sensor to the new plant
setup.move.moveHint: The current plant stays, but it no longer has a sensor.
setup.linked.title: Your sensor is already on a plant
setup.linked.body: Your sensor is already on a plant. Check your plant list.
setup.linked.unknownTitle: The save could not be confirmed
setup.linked.unknownBody: Check your plant list. The plant may already be saved there.
setup.notMoved.title: The new plant was not saved
setup.notMoved.body: The sensor stays on its current plant. The plant you just entered was not saved. Check your plant list.
setup.done.title: All set!
setup.done.body: {plantName} is connected. The first reading arrives within the hour. The sensor measures every 15 minutes.
validation.ssid.long: A network name has at most 32 bytes.
validation.wifiPassword.length: A Wi-Fi password has {min} to {max} characters.
validation.wifiPassword.open: This network is open, so it needs no password.
validation.deviceName.control: The name cannot contain line breaks or control characters.
plants.title: My plants
plants.empty.title: No plants yet
plants.empty.body: Add your first sensor to see your plants here. There is no limit on plants or sensors.
plants.error.load: Could not load your plants. Check your connection and try again.
plants.error.notConnected: Plants are not connected to a server yet.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.intro: Worked out from the last 7 days of readings. Push notifications are not built yet, so alerts show on this screen only.
alerts.empty.title: No alerts right now
alerts.empty.body: A plant shows up here when its soil is too dry or too wet, the sensor battery is low, or the sensor has not reported for more than 3 h 10 min.
alerts.error.load: Could not load alerts. Check your connection and try again.
alerts.text.too_dry: Soil moisture {value} %, below the dry limit of {threshold} %.
alerts.text.too_wet: Soil moisture {value} %, above the wet limit of {threshold} %.
alerts.text.device_offline: No report from the sensor for {hours} h {minutes} min.
plant.error.load: Could not load this plant. Try again.
plant.updated.never: No report from the sensor yet
plant.latest.title: Latest reading
plant.chart.title: Soil moisture, last 7 days (hourly)
plant.chart.a11y: Soil moisture, last 7 days, {points} hourly points, lowest {min} %, highest {max} %, latest {last} %
plant.chart.empty: No readings in the last 7 days.
plant.chart.premiumHint: Free accounts see 7 days. Longer history is part of Premium.
plant.remove.error: Nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again.
plant.removed.releaseError: The sensor could not be released. Try again.
plant.meta.a11y: Location: {location}. Room or area: {room}. Soil type: {soil}.
hourly.title: Hourly readings, last 7 days
hourly.empty: No hourly rows in the last 7 days.
hourly.a11y: Hourly readings, newest first: {rows} hours, {gaps} without a report.
gallery.title: Photos of {plantName}
gallery.empty.title: No photos yet
gallery.empty.body: Photos of this plant appear here. There is no limit on the number of photos.
gallery.error: Could not load the photos. Try again.
plant.remove.exportHint: Export your data before you delete. The JSON export includes all your photos and unlocks deleting once everything is saved. The CSV export does not contain photos and does not unlock deleting.
plant.remove.exported: Export ready: {fileName} (your data and {photoCount} photos). You can delete now.
plant.remove.exportError: The export failed. Nothing was removed. Try again.
plant.remove.exportRequired: Export first. The delete button unlocks after the export.
plant.removed.photosLeft: {n} photo(s) could not be deleted from storage yet.
plant.removed.photosError: Photo cleanup failed again. Try later.
deleteAccount.exported: Export ready: {fileName} (your data and {photoCount} photos). You can delete now.
export.photos.failed: The export could not be completed: {failed} of {total} photos could not be downloaded. Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Check your connection and tap the export button again.
export.photos.expired: The export could not be completed: the photo links have expired or are no longer valid. Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Tap the export button again to get fresh links.
export.photos.rejected: The export could not be completed: it pointed to photo links on a server the app does not trust, so it did not download them. Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Try again later; if it happens again, contact support.
export.photos.noList: The export could not be completed: it did not include a list of your photos, so the app cannot tell if a copy would be complete. Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Try again later.
export.photos.none: The export could not be completed: the server listed your photos but none of them had a file the app could download. Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Try again later; if it happens again, contact support.
export.photos.tooLarge: Your photos are too large for the in-app export. Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Use a smaller photo library or contact support for a manual export.
export.photos.archive: The export could not be completed: the archive could not be built on this device (it may be too large or the phone ran out of memory). Nothing was saved to your device and delete stays locked. Close other apps and try again, or contact support.
export.photos.missing: {n} photo(s) listed by the server had no file and could not be included.
export.csvIncomplete: {fileName} saved. The CSV lists your photos but does not contain them, so delete stays locked. Use the JSON export for a complete copy.
export.confirm.title: Did you save your export?
export.confirm.body: Delete stays locked until you have the file. Did you save {fileName} (for example to Files, Drive or by email to yourself)?
deleteAccount.exportError: The export did not work. Nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again.
deleteAccount.exportRequired: Export first. The delete button unlocks after the export.
deleteAccount.error.network: No connection, so we do not know whether the deletion went through. Some of your data may already be deleted. Check your internet and try again. If you are signed out or this keeps happening, sign in again to check, or contact the team.
deleteAccount.error.gate: Not deleted. Export your data first and type DELETE. Nothing was removed.
deleteAccount.error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Nothing was removed. Sign out, sign in again and retry.
deleteAccount.error.unauthorizedAfterErr: Your sign-in is no longer accepted. Your account may already have been deleted by the earlier attempt. Sign in again to check: if that fails, the account is gone. If it works and the data is still there, try again or contact the team.
dashboard.title: Premium dashboard
dashboard.intro: 30- and 90-day history of your plants, worked out from your own readings.
dashboard.error: Could not load the dashboard. Check your connection and try again.
dashboard.profileError: Could not check your plan. Nothing was loaded. Try again.
dashboard.upgrade.title: Premium feature
dashboard.upgrade.body: The premium dashboard shows 30- and 90-day history for each plant: soil moisture, battery, watering event counts and trends. It is part of Premium. Free accounts do not load any plant history.

dashboard.noReadings: No readings in this period yet.

dashboard.plant.battery: Battery: mean {mean} V, min {min} V, max {max} V
dashboard.plant.trend: Trend: soil {change} points (first week {first} %, last week {last} %)
dashboard.range.label: Soil moisture range from {min} % to {max} %, mean {mean} %

dashboard.plant.noTrend: Trend: not enough readings in both the first and the last week.
